# VoiceTester — 100% Offline On-Device Microphone Tester

> VoiceTester is a private, client-side, on-device audio latency, waveform inspection, background noise analysis, and microphone diagnostic testing suite. All digital signal processing (DSP) and audio recording runs 100% locally in browser memory without sending any audio bytes to external servers.

## Features and Capabilities
- Real-time Audio Hardware Inspection: Test input channels, sample rates, acoustic echo cancellation (AEC), noise suppression, and auto gain control (AGC).
- Live Oscilloscope & Audio Spectrogram: Real-time 60fps canvas-rendered time-domain waveforms and FFT frequency spectrum visualizations.
- Direct Monitoring ("Hear Yourself"): Ultra-low latency hardware feedback loop.
- Acoustic Health Benchmark: Automated 5-second test measuring Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR), Noise Floor dB, Clipping Frequency, and Vocal Clarity.
- Multi-format Recording: In-browser lossless WAV, WebM, MP3, and M4A audio export.

## Key Links

- [Acoustic Benchmark Suite](https://voicetester.100xadi.com/benchmark): Automated 5-second microphone health and SNR diagnostic tests.
